_readme: Owner decisions on bills the identifiers do not link (packages/ingest/src/identity/bill-merge.ts, D-050). 'same': one dossier seen from two pages; the merge step folds the second record into the first like any duplicate. 'different': two bills that must never be merged. A 'different' pair the identifiers would join stops the merge with an error. Evidence: who filed them (bill_sponsors), registrations and dates.
